module: Event node "On Vehicle Spawned" (category `logic`). Emits a pulse on `flow` and the id `vehId` when a vehicle is created (hook `onVehicleSpawned`).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

_afterTrigger.desc: Called by the manager after the node is triggered; resets the event flag to false.

_executionStarted.desc: Called by the manager when the flowgraph project execution starts; resets the internal state to zero.

onVehicleSpawned.desc: Hook called when a vehicle is created; stores `id` and raises the flag.

work.desc: If the flag is raised, fills `vehId` and sets `flow` to true for one frame, otherwise false.
